subject: Compute DELTA11 plan: threadgroup selector refusal + inert compute pipeline; TeguTexture not compute-owned
body:
Read C4 blockers. Plan before edits:
1) TeguEncoder gains setThreadgroupMemoryLength:atIndex: storing per-index lengths (index<31, <=32KiB; malformed invalid). Because TGP2 currently carries only static module WLS word18 and no dynamic-length transport, both dispatch entry points will explicitly invalidate/refuse any dispatch with a nonzero dynamic length and emit a bounded TEGU_COMPUTE_REFUSED line; no job and no guessed WLS. maxThreadgroupMemoryLength remains 0 until lowering defines a dynamic WLS transport. Lowering: if you add a package/wire field for dynamic WLS, send exact contract; current behavior is explicit refusal.
2) Under TEGU_INERT_PIPELINES, compute pipeline creation failures in backboardd (using delta10 exported tegu_compositor_process_is_backboardd) return a nonnil TeguPipeline with inert=1; dispatch drops with a bounded TEGU_INERT_COMPUTE_DISPATCH trace and no job. Other processes/flag-off stay nil/NSError. Host test uses host process seam.
3) TeguTexture/newTextureViewWithPixelFormat is in metal/tegu/render_encoder.inc (render-owned), not compute files; I will not edit it. Render/textures should apply their patch.
No cargo/native/phone. Will post hashes/tests.
